اقتعدنا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَعَدْنَا (iqtaʕadnā) /iq.ta.ʕad.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اُقْتُعِدْنَا (uqtuʕidnā) /uq.tu.ʕid.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
